title: Accessible and presentable infinity categories
statement:
Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$; small means $\mathcal U$-small and the quasicategories $\mathcal C$ and indexing quasicategories below fit in $\mathcal U'$. Use simplicial sets and nondegenerate simplices from [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], space categories $\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ and the covariant corepresented mapping-space functors from [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], and quasicategories, equivalences, coherent diagrams, cocones and colimits from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For an infinite regular cardinal $\kappa\in\mathcal U$, a simplicial set is $\kappa$-small if its set of nondegenerate simplices has cardinality less than $\kappa$. A quasicategory $I$ is $\kappa$-filtered if every coherent diagram $K\to I$ for a $\kappa$-small simplicial set $K$ admits a cocone; $K=\varnothing$ is included. A quasicategory $\mathcal C$ is locally small if each mapping space is equivalent to a small space. It admits small $\kappa$-filtered colimits if all diagrams indexed by small $\kappa$-filtered quasicategories have colimits.

When these colimits exist, an object $c\in\mathcal C$ is $\kappa$-compact if the covariant corepresented coherent functor $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(c,-):\mathcal C\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U\prime}$ preserves every small $\kappa$-filtered colimiting cocone: for every such diagram $F:I\to\mathcal C$ and every colimiting cocone $\lambda:F\to\Delta_I L$, the image cocone with components $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(c,F(i))\to\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal C}(c,L)$ is colimiting in the infinity category of $\mathcal U\prime$-small spaces $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U\prime}$ (formed in a further ambient universe). The category $\mathcal C$ is $\kappa$-accessible if it is locally small, admits small $\kappa$-filtered colimits and has an essentially small full subcategory of $\kappa$-compact objects such that every object of $\mathcal C$ is a colimit of a small $\kappa$-filtered diagram taking values in that subcategory. Essentially small means equivalent to a small quasicategory. Accessible means $\kappa$-accessible for some infinite regular $\kappa\in\mathcal U$. Presentable means accessible and admitting colimits of all diagrams indexed by small simplicial sets. A coherent functor preserves a class of colimits if it sends every colimiting cocone in that class to a colimiting cocone.
